items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for new public launches, monetization expansion, security-sensitive exposure, and the proposed totaljerks.com CTA implementation. Evidence: compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings remain. Analytics and SEO evidence are available for measured sites, but incomplete telemetry alone is not a growth blocker. Revenue reports 453 totaljerks.com tracking-ID clicks and 0 site-attributed ordered items; the $4.92 aggregate commission is unattributed, so revenue, ROI, margin, causal-lift, and upside claims are unsupported. Security and operations sweeps remain unavailable. Exact decision: retain only no-spend, no-credential, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking, no-cross-site reversible work; keep new launches and monetization changes gated.

SearchWoot launch-readiness remains blocked and private. Progress is 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed; no task may close. Woot API deal and price-history use is blocked because current evidence confirms access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights, while public terms restrict commercial/public reuse. User alerts, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare processing are evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the source-rights matrix, repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and GA4 settings capture, log/vendor/DPA inventory, and incident/deletion/correction/request procedures. Prepare, but do not send, a human-counsel-reviewed permission request. Keep the private gate unchanged.

Launch-readiness data-use decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; smallest action is a dated field-level rights matrix plus counsel-reviewed, unsent permission request. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; smallest action is a read-only data-flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor, consent, and unsubscribe table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; smallest action is a read-only capture of deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction scope. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; smallest action is a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request-workflow inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, notification, vendor, and future affiliate or advertising questions.
